Recording is already allowed. If Mika still can’t hear you, open the phone’s permission manager and check that Mika’s microphone isn’t switched off separately. Another app may also be using it.
This phone has no built-in speech recognition, and no speech-to-text model has been picked. Pick a provider’s speech model in Settings › Models › Speech to text and it will work.
Speech to text is set to the phone’s built-in recognition, but this phone doesn’t have it now. Pick another one in Settings › Models › Speech to text.
The phone’s built-in speech recognition didn’t respond, so no words came through. Pick a provider’s speech model in Settings › Models › Speech to text and it will work.
The provider of the chosen speech model has been removed. Pick another one in Settings › Models › Speech to text.
Speech to text is turned off. Pick one in Settings › Models › Speech to text.
To hear you while you hold to talk, Mika needs to record audio. It was denied before, so the phone won’t ask again. Turn on the microphone on Mika’s permission page in system settings.
